constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

subjects.description: the black sports car; carbon fibre body
subjects.retention_details: Preserve this canonical target identity and its listed stable attributes.

claims.text: Keep the observed black sports car identity and carbon fibre body, redraw the scene as 1990s cel animation, and show the car moving through a snowy street without copying the source showroom background or static pose.
The reference presents the black sports car with a carbon fibre body as an identity reference for the target car.
The specific snowy city street layout, low buildings, streetlamp halos, drifting flakes, snow banks, slush spray and gentle bend are creative additions permitted by the request.

description.text: On a snow-covered city street, the 1990s cel-animation scene opens in a wide view. In the opening,

rolls into view from the left, its low carbon fibre body catching pale highlights from the overcast winter light. The car presses fresh tracks into the snow as flakes drift past low buildings and streetlamps. The camera holds a static shot while the car enters and begins moving forward. Snow banks line the pavement, and the street recedes in cool blue-grey tones. The low buildings have dark windows and simple winter awnings, while the streetlamps cast soft halos through the falling snow. The falling flakes drift at different depths, giving the wide frame a quiet winter atmosphere. Newly generated sound carries the crunch of tyres on fresh snow and a low engine note.
At the start,
rolls into view from the left and presses fresh tracks into the snow.
The crunch of tyres on fresh snow and a low engine note begin.
Flakes drift past the low buildings and streetlamps as the
moves forward.
The shot cuts to a medium-wide tracking view.

accelerates gently through the snow, its carbon fibre body passing the streetlamps while slush sprays from the rear wheels. The camera tracks with the car at small amplitude and slow speed. More of the snowy street slides past, with packed snow, dark kerbs and soft drifts. The engine rises slightly as the car picks up speed, and the tyres hiss through the slush. The car remains the clear focus against the muted street. Its dark body contrasts with the white snow, and the streetlamps throw brief highlights along the roof and side panels. The camera keeps a steady distance, letting the car's motion and the spray of slush read clearly. A few distant windows glow faintly, but the street stays subdued and cold.
The view follows as
accelerates gently and slush sprays from the rear wheels.
Slush hisses under the tyres and the engine rises slightly.
Streetlamps pass by as

The shot cuts to a medium view as

The camera pans right with small amplitude and slow speed, following the car until it recedes into the snowfall. Windblown snow crosses the frame, and the engine fades with distance. The bend opens between low buildings, with snow-covered pavement and streetlamps continuing into the background. The car's carbon fibre body flashes once under a lamp before the snow softens its outline. Fresh tracks curve through the snow behind the car, marking its path around the bend. The scene resolves on the empty street as the last engine note dies away.
The bend takes the view as
sweeps around it and heads away.
Windblown snow whispers and the engine begins to fade.
Far down the street,
grows smaller and recedes into the falling snow.
